name: Interval Arithmetic Inclusion Strategies
definition: Four strategies for computing interval bounds of an implicit function f over a 3D box. They trade off between generality (black-box compatibility) and tightness of bounds (performance/accuracy).
summary: Interval Arithmetic Inclusion Strategies provide conservative bounds for implicit functions to enable robust ray casting pruning, distinguished by a spectrum of trade-offs between black-box compatibility and bound tightness.
